test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A policeman starts chasing a thief from a distance of 600 metres. The speed of the policeman and the thief are 12 km/h and 10 km/h respectively. How long will it take for the thief to be caught?
solution:
Given:

A policeman notices a thief from a distance = 600 m.

A policeman runs at the rate of 12 km/hr

And thief run at the rate of 10 km/hr

Formula used:

Distance = speed x time

Calculation:

Relative speed = (12 - 10)km/hr = 2 km/hr

Time = 600/(2 × 5/18)

⇒ 1080 sec = 1080/60 = 18 minutes

∴ The answer is 18 minutes.
